title: 1. Evaluating forecasts: reproducing the published results
text: Monthly excess returns 12 Fama-French industry portfolios, January 1964 December 2023. Rolling 60-month estimation windows following 36-month evaluation windows, stepping one month. Training moments forecast; realised moments test window truth. Weights use ridge-shrunk covariance inverse; tangency portfolio normalised full investment.
code: R <- as.matrix(ff12[, -1]) train_len <- 60L; test_len <- 36L dates <- ff12$date c(months = nrow(R), assets = ncol(R),   windows = nrow(R) - train_len - test_len + 1L) #>  months  assets windows  #>     720      12     625 ridge_inverse <- function(Rw, alpha = 0.20) {   S  <- stats::cov(Rw)   Ss <- (1 - alpha) * S + alpha * diag(diag(S))   ev <- eigen(Ss, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values   if (min(ev) < 1e-6) Ss <- Ss + diag(abs(min(ev)) + 1e-4, ncol(Ss))   solve(Ss) } budget   <- function(w) w / sum(w) sharpe   <- function(w, R_test) { r <- drop(R_test %*% w); mean(r) / stats::sd(r) }

title: 1. Evaluating forecasts: reproducing the published results
text: Two strategies: tangency portfolio, needs moments, global minimum-variance portfolio, needs covariance. Keep difference mind — becomes point later.
code: variants <- c("none", "cc05", "cc0", "cv", "i") starts   <- seq_len(nrow(R) - train_len - test_len + 1L) ones     <- rep(1, ncol(R))  panel <- do.call(rbind, lapply(starts, function(s) {   tr <- R[s:(s + train_len - 1L), ]   te <- R[(s + train_len):(s + train_len + test_len - 1L), ]    mu_hat <- colMeans(tr)   Sigma_hat <- stats::cov(tr)   Sigma_w_inv <- ridge_inverse(tr)    mu <- colMeans(te); Sigma <- stats::cov(te); Sigma_inv <- solve(Sigma)    sr_tan <- sharpe(budget(drop(Sigma_w_inv %*% mu_hat)), te)   sr_gmv <- sharpe(budget(drop(Sigma_w_inv %*% ones)), te)   or_tan <- sqrt(drop(t(mu) %*% Sigma_inv %*% mu))       # perfect foresight   or_gmv <- sharpe(budget(drop(Sigma_inv %*% ones)), te)    c(vapply(variants, function(v) compute_rafe(mu_hat, mu, Sigma, variant = v),            numeric(1)),     setNames(vapply(variants, function(v) as.numeric(       compute_trafe(mu_hat, mu, Sigma, Sigma_hat, variant = v, SR_star = or_tan)),       numeric(1)), paste0("T_", variants)),     setNames(vapply(variants, function(v) as.numeric(       compute_trafe(mu_hat, mu, Sigma, Sigma_hat, variant = v, SR_star = or_gmv)),       numeric(1)), paste0("G_", variants)),     crafe = compute_crafe(Sigma, Sigma_hat),     sr_tan = sr_tan, sr_gmv = sr_gmv, or_tan = or_tan, or_gmv = or_gmv,     gap_tan = or_tan - sr_tan, gap_gmv = or_gmv - sr_gmv) })) panel <- as.data.frame(panel) panel$date <- dates[starts + train_len] nrow(panel) #> [1] 625

title: 0. rafe — getting started
text: compute_trafe() combines paper’s total error returns decomposition attributes. Pass c = NULL guaranteed upper bound, carries data-dependent constant (c=1c = 1 RAFE≤SR*\mathrm{RAFE} \le SR^{*}, else c=2c = 2):
code: data(ff12) R <- as.matrix(ff12[, -1])  train <- R[1:60, ] eval  <- R[61:120, ]  mu_hat <- colMeans(train); Sigma_hat <- stats::cov(train) mu     <- colMeans(eval);  Sigma     <- stats::cov(eval)  compute_rafe(mu_hat, mu, Sigma = Sigma) #> [1] 0.9526 compute_crafe(Sigma, Sigma_hat) #> [1] 4.557 bound <- compute_trafe(mu_hat, mu, Sigma, Sigma_hat) bound #> [1] 3.594 #> attr(,"rafe") #> [1] 0.9526 #> attr(,"crafe") #> [1] 4.557 #> attr(,"c") #> [1] 1 #> attr(,"SR_star") #> [1] 0.5796 unlist(attributes(bound)) #>    rafe   crafe       c SR_star  #>  0.9526  4.5570  1.0000  0.5796

title: 2. Post-processing forecasts: correcting the moments you were handed
text: mu_rafe_stein() shrinks mean toward target intensity κ\kappa, computing intensity Σ̂−1/2\hat\Sigma^{-1/2}-whitened space. Pass T_obs positive-part James-Stein intensity implied sample size: corrector pulls cross-section toward grand mean leaving grand mean untouched: sigma_crafe_floor() lifts small eigenvalues Σ̂\hat\Sigma floor set relative mean eigenvalue. small eigenvalues exactly directions mean-variance optimiser leverages hardest, exactly sample covariance least trustworthy:
code: window    <- R[1:60, ] mu_hat    <- colMeans(window) Sigma_hat <- stats::cov(window)  mu_js <- mu_rafe_stein(mu_hat, Sigma_hat, T_obs = 60) attr(mu_js, "kappa") #> [1] 0.3704  round(rbind(raw = mu_hat, corrected = as.numeric(mu_js)), 4)[, 1:6] #>            NoDur  Durbl  Manuf  Enrgy  Chems  BusEq #> raw       0.0083 0.0042 0.0098 0.0078 0.0024 0.0124 #> corrected 0.0078 0.0053 0.0088 0.0075 0.0041 0.0104 c(raw = mean(mu_hat), corrected = mean(mu_js),   raw_spread = sd(mu_hat), corrected_spread = sd(mu_js)) #>              raw        corrected       raw_spread corrected_spread  #>         0.007029         0.007029         0.004908         0.003090 lam_raw <- eigen(Sigma_hat, symmetric = TRUE)$values lam_cln <- eigen(sigma_crafe_floor(Sigma_hat, 0.3), symmetric = TRUE)$values round(rbind(raw = lam_raw, floored = lam_cln), 5) #>            [,1]    [,2]  [,3]    [,4]  [,5]    [,6]    [,7]    [,8]    [,9] #> raw     0.01264 0.00166 0.001 0.00071 6e-04 0.00039 0.00033 0.00027 0.00022 #> floored 0.01264 0.00166 0.001 0.00071 6e-04 0.00045 0.00045 0.00045 0.00045 #>           [,10]   [,11]   [,12] #> raw     0.00018 0.00009 0.00005 #> floored 0.00045 0.00045 0.00045 c(condition_raw = max(lam_raw) / min(lam_raw),   condition_floored = max(lam_cln) / min(lam_cln)) #>     condition_raw condition_floored  #>            262.58             27.87

text: Neither intensity picked hand. tuners split training window inner-training inner-validation block (40 + 20 months default), fit first score second. differ score. sep_tune() tunes parameter channel — κ\kappa inner-validation RAFE, τ\tau inner-validation C-RAFE. joint_trafe_tune() searches full (κ,τ)(\kappa, \tau) grid inner-validation T-RAFE. sep_tune() returns two loss profiles, can see whether optimum interior sitting grid edge:
code: kg <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.05) tg <- seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.05)  fit_sep   <- sep_tune(window, kappa_grid = kg, tau_grid = tg) fit_joint <- joint_trafe_tune(window, kappa_grid = kg, tau_grid = tg)  rbind(sep   = c(kappa = fit_sep$kappa,   tau = fit_sep$tau_rel),       joint = c(kappa = fit_joint$kappa, tau = fit_joint$tau_rel)) #>       kappa tau #> sep       1 0.5 #> joint     1 0.5 op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.4, 1)) plot(kg, fit_sep$losses_kappa, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "steelblue",      xlab = expression(kappa), ylab = "inner-validation RAFE",      main = "Mean channel") abline(v = fit_sep$kappa, lty = 2) plot(tg, fit_sep$losses_tau, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "darkorange",      xlab = expression(tau), ylab = "inner-validation C-RAFE",      main = "Covariance channel") abline(v = fit_sep$tau_rel, lty = 2) par(op)

title: RAFE-Stein-Corrected Mean — mu_rafe_stein
text: Writing \(\hat m := \hat\Sigma^{-1/2}\hat\mu\) \(m_0 := \hat\Sigma^{-1/2}\mu_0\) whitened forecast target, James–Stein map Salcher, Stöckl & Hanke $$JS(z) = m_0 + \left(1 - \frac{N-2}{T\,\|z - m_0\|_2^2}\right)_{+}(z - m_0),$$ corrected mean \(\tilde\mu = \hat\Sigma^{1/2} JS(\hat m)\). \(\|\hat m - m_0\|_2^2 = (\hat\mu - \mu_0)^\top \hat\Sigma^{-1} (\hat\mu - \mu_0)\), algebraically linear shrinkage raw space whose intensity computed risk metric: \(\tilde\mu = (1 - \kappa)\hat\mu + \kappa\mu_0\). Supply T_obs use James–Stein intensity, kappa fix intensity directly (sep_tune() joint_trafe_tune() search ). Exactly one two required.

title: RAFE-Stein-Corrected Mean — mu_rafe_stein
text: Stöckl, S., Salcher, L., & Hanke, M. Post-Optimal Moment Correction Mean-Variance Portfolios. Working paper.
